description: This file defines a Flutter widget called CategoryPieChart that renders a responsive pie chart with labels, percentages, and optional legend, using the fl_chart package. It handles empty data gracefully and provides customization options for radius, label angles, and height.

classes.name: CategoryPieChart
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that renders a pie chart with labeled slices and optional legend. It processes input slices data to generate chart sections and associated legend items, handling empty or invalid data with a placeholder.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, rendering either the pie chart with legend or an empty placeholder if there's no data.
